title: fix(layout): the mobile tab bar draws only the entries its sidebar draws (objectui#11362)
body:
Fixes #11362
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`AppSchemaRenderer`'s mobile tab bar (`mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'`, the module-private `MobileBottomNav`) now draws only the entries its sidebar draws.

- `collectLeaves` asks `hasVisibleNavigationItems` about each node on its own, with the guard inputs the sidebar and the area derivation get. That predicate runs `passesNavItemGuards` (`visible`, `requiredPermissions`, the `requiresObject` / `requiresService` capability gates, a `doc` entry's target), then lets a group survive only through a visible child and an `action` entry only when `onAction` is wired. This is the sidebar's own per-node answer. ⛔ No second copy of the guard.
- The guard runs before the five-tab cap, so a hidden entry takes no slot. A group the viewer may not see takes its entries off the bar, as it does in the sidebar.
- An `action` entry is drawn the sidebar's way: a button (`type="button"`) whose click hands the whole item to `onAction`. With no `onAction` it is left off the bar, which is when the sidebar hides it too.
- `AppSchemaRenderer` builds one guard-options object and gives it to both the area derivation and the bar. It is built from the arguments `InternalSidebar` hands `NavigationRenderer`.

Files: `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`, the pin file `packages/layout/src/__tests__/AppSchemaRenderer.mobileTabGuard-11362.test.tsx`, and `.changeset/11362-mobile-tab-bar-nav-guard.md` (`@object-ui/layout` patch). `NavigationRenderer.tsx` is untouched.

## Route taken (differs from the dispatch's suggested route)

The dispatch suggested exporting `passesNavItemGuards`. Measured: `packages/layout/src/index.ts` has `export * from './NavigationRenderer'`, so that export would have joined `@object-ui/layout`'s published entry point. `hasVisibleNavigationItems` is already exported and is the predicate the area derivation and the sidebar's group check use. Called on a single node, it executes `passesNavItemGuards` and the sidebar's group and action rules. So the bar goes through the one shared guard and adds no export, the published entry points are byte-unchanged, and the claim's `Clause-②: no` holds as written. `AppSchemaRendererProps` is unchanged. The two new props are on the module-private `MobileBottomNav`.

## Premises verified first (at `main` `8673402`)

1. `collectLeaves` flattened groups, skipped separators and applied no entry guard, and the five-tab slice came before any guard. Reproduced through the real `AppSchemaRenderer`: the new pins ran against the unmodified source and gave **6 failed / 1 passed** (the control passed). The sidebar half of each row passed, so the sidebar hid what the bar drew. A probe read the action tab as a link with href `/`.
2. The sidebar's guard inputs (`evalVis`, `checkPerm`, `checkCap`, `checkDocTarget`, `onAction`) are locals of `AppSchemaRenderer`, which hands them to `InternalSidebar`. `MobileBottomNav` is rendered by the same function, so it can receive them as internal props with no new public prop.
3. `onAction` is in scope where the bar is rendered, so the bar can draw the sidebar's action button. Branch taken: **rendered as a button when `onAction` is wired, dropped when it is not**, matching the sidebar on both sides.
4. Five-tab cap: pinned with six entries, one of them hidden.

## Pins

All pins go through the real `AppSchemaRenderer`. Each row asserts both the bar and the sidebar row for the same entry. The checker grants `crm.read` only.

| row | bar | sidebar |
|:--|:--|:--|
| control: a plain entry, and one whose `requiredPermissions` are granted | drawn, link | drawn, link |
| `visible: false` | not drawn | not drawn |
| `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks | not drawn | not drawn |
| `type: 'action'`, no `onAction` | not drawn | not drawn |
| `type: 'action'`, `onAction` wired | button, click passes the whole item | button |
| six entries, one hidden | the five visible, including the sixth | n/a |
| gated group, plus an open group (control) | gated child not drawn, open child drawn | same |

## Ablations (one-time proofs, run at `9ac62b5` after the fix was committed)

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the sibling objectstack checkout. That tool checks the anchor hits exactly once, the on-disk blob changes, and the restore brings the blob back to the HEAD blob `b3313fdb7d37` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. All three restores passed. Tests import `../AppSchemaRenderer` relatively, so no `dist/` is on the path and no rebuild was needed. The direction was predicted before each run.

- **A, guard line deleted from `collectLeaves`:** predicted 5 red. Observed **5 failed / 2 passed**: `visible`, denied, action without `onAction`, six-entry cap and gated group went red. The control and the action-with-`onAction` row stayed green.
- **B, action-button branch disabled:** predicted 1 red. Observed **1 failed / 6 passed**: the action-with-`onAction` row went red ("expected 'A' to be 'BUTTON'").
- **C, guard moved after the five-tab slice:** predicted 2 red. Observed **2 failed / 5 passed**: the six-entry cap and gated group rows went red.

## Gates (final head `2a1af96`, after merging `main` at `b4075c0`)

Each exit code was captured to a file before any pipe.

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/layout^...' build` gives exit 0 (9 of 47 projects). It was rebuilt after the merge because `packages/types` moved.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/layout type-check` gives exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin file, so its types are checked.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/layout/` together with the 19 app-shell suites that import `@object-ui/layout`, `scripts/__tests__/component-registrations.test.ts` and `packages/types/src/__tests__/content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts` gives exit 0: **54 files, 1247 tests passed** (layout alone: 33 files, 328 tests).
- `eslint .` in `packages/layout` (the package's `lint` script) gives exit 0: 42 files (counted from `--format json`), 0 errors. `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` carries the same two warnings as at base (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`, `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` on the area-election effect). `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so no type-aware linting is enabled and this diff cannot move another package's lint verdict.
- These all exit 0: `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:handler-key-reads`, `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`, `node scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs`, the three `check-vi-mock-*` gates, `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs`, `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` and `node scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` exited 2 on its prerequisite (no console build on disk). That is not a measurement. The registration and `sideEffects` are untouched, so it is not a gate this diff needs.
- `check:readme-exports` was not run because no export was added.

## Acceptance notes

- These are UI visibility gates, not data access. A route behind a wrongly drawn tab still answered with its own server-side checks.
- Out of scope, measured and reported to the seat, not touched here: the bar ignores `order`, while the sidebar sorts each level by `order`. Probe: two entries with `order` 2 and 1 come out in authored order on the bar and in `order` order in the sidebar. With more than five entries, the cap therefore keeps the first five by authored position. This is the same "bar answers differently from the sidebar" family as objectui#11211 and this card. A fix here would need a second copy of the sidebar's sort or a new export, so it is not in this PR.
- No doc describes which entries the bottom bar draws (`content/docs/guide/layout.md` and the layout README do not mention `mobileNavMode`), so there was no doc text to update.
- Toolchain: the container's Node 22.22.0 fails the repo's `engine-strict` install (`jsdom@30.0.1` needs 22.22.2 or later). Everything here ran under Node 22.22.2 installed through the container's nvm.
